mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_CONTENT_FILE_FOLDER_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS(FOLDER_ID,SCOPE_TYPE,OWNER_USER_ID,WS_ID,PROJ_ID,PARENT_FOLDER_ID,FOLDER_NAME,SORT_ORDER,CREATED_BY,CREATED_AT,UPDATED_BY,UPDATED_AT,DELETED_YN) VALUES(#{folderId},#{scopeType},#{ownerUserId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{wsId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{projId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{parentFolderId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{folderName},0,#{createdBy},SYSDATE,#{createdBy},SYSDATE,'N')
mapper.sql: f.SCOPE_TYPE=#{scopeType} AND f.OWNER_USER_ID=#{ownerUserId} AND f.WS_ID=#{wsId} AND f.PROJ_ID=#{projId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS f WHERE f.FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND f.DELETED_YN='N'

SELECT f.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS c WHERE c.PARENT_FOLDER_ID=f.FOLDER_ID AND c.DELETED_YN='N') CHILD_FOLDER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILES x WHERE x.FOLDER_ID=f.FOLDER_ID AND x.DELETED_YN='N') FILE_COUNT FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS f WHERE AND f.DELETED_YN='N' ORDER BY f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID NULLS FIRST,f.SORT_ORDER,f.FOLDER_NAME

SELECT f.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS c WHERE c.PARENT_FOLDER_ID=f.FOLDER_ID AND c.DELETED_YN='N') CHILD_FOLDER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILES x WHERE x.FOLDER_ID=f.FOLDER_ID AND x.DELETED_YN='N') FILE_COUNT FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS f WHERE AND f.DELETED_YN='N' AND f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID IS NULLAND f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID=#{parentFolderId} ORDER BY f.SORT_ORDER,f.FOLDER_NAME

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS f WHERE AND f.DELETED_YN='N' AND UPPER(f.FOLDER_NAME)=UPPER(#{folderName}) AND f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID IS NULLAND f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID=#{parentFolderId}AND f.FOLDER_ID<>#{excludeFolderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS SET FOLDER_NAME=#{folderName},UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS SET PARENT_FOLDER_ID=#{parentFolderId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS SET DELETED_YN='Y',DELETED_BY=#{userId},DELETED_AT=SYSDATE,UPDATED_BY=#{userId},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND DELETED_YN='N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS WHERE PARENT_FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND DELETED_YN='N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILES WHERE FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND DELETED_YN='N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILES WHERE DELETED_YN = 'N' AND NVL(CREATED_BY, -1) <> #{userId} AND FOLDER_ID IN ( SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILE_FOLDERS WHERE DELETED_YN = 'N' START WITH FOLDER_ID = #{folderId} CONNECT BY PRIOR FOLDER_ID = PARENT_FOLDER_ID )
